context: Tests replacing stale host/default copies with accessible owning source links while retaining operational rationale, recovery, and useful command syntax.

checklist.name: Inventory owns host facts
checklist.description: docs/agents.md replaces the host/address inventory copy with a valid relative link to inventory/agents.yaml instead of updating or extending a second host list.

checklist.name: Config owns defaults
checklist.description: docs/agents.md links config/agent-defaults.yaml and identifies the relevant settings without manually repeating their values; future value changes alone would not require updating this Markdown.

checklist.name: Restart example remains useful
checklist.description: The repeated per-host restart catalogue becomes a reusable, accurate restart example with a clear way to select a host from the inventory.

checklist.name: Rationale retained
checklist.description: The heartbeat tradeoff and bandwidth-budget constraint remain available because the config does not express that rationale.

checklist.name: Recovery and retirement retained
checklist.description: The rollback command, heartbeat confirmation, remote-data consequence, log export, and monitoring cleanup remain actionable.

checklist.name: Scope and proof respected
checklist.description: Only docs/agents.md and doc-report.md change; the report accurately describes the inspected sources and actual checks without claiming host operations or unexecuted validation.
